Room.title: Online Arena Room
Room.description: Metadata for an internet multiplayer worm arena hosted on a player's device.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

hostName.description: Display nickname of the host player.

roomName.description: Title of the online room shown in the server list.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the hosted arena.

active.description: True while the room is open for players to discover and join.

arenaRadius.description: Circular arena radius in world units.

includeBots.description: Whether AI bots populate the arena alongside players.

playerCount.description: Current number of human players in the room.

maxPlayers.description: Maximum allowed human players in the room.

tick.description: Latest simulation tick published by the host.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the latest room update.

RoomPlayer.title: Online Room Player Input
RoomPlayer.description: Real-time steering, boost, and respawn input document owned by a joined player.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joined player.

hostUid.description: Denormalized host UID matching the parent room for local query security.

boosting.description: Whether turbo boost is currently held.

respawnSeq.description: Monotonic counter incremented when requesting a respawn.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the player joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the player's latest input.

RoomLiveState.title: Online Arena Live State
RoomLiveState.description: Host-authoritative live arena state with worms, packed food orbs, and death summaries.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

killFeed.description: Latest kill feed banner text or empty string.

worms.description: List of worm state maps serialized by the host.

orbs.description: Flat packed integer list encoding active food orbs.

deaths.description: List of recent death summary maps keyed by player uid.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the live state snapshot.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Publicly discoverable active online rooms hosted by players.

/rooms/{roomId}/players/{playerUid}.description: Joined players and their real-time steering inputs inside a room.

/rooms/{roomId}/state/{stateId}.description: Host-published live game state (document ID: live).
